Name: New Leave — Substitute Consent Accepted (No Loop)
Status / Purpose: Substitute-consent prefix; accepted response routes to applicant-appropriate next approval state.

Name: New Leave — Substitute Declined, Replacement Accepted (One Loop Traversal)
Status / Purpose: Exactly one substitute-decline recovery traversal ending in accepted replacement.

Name: New CL/RH — Approved
Status / Purpose: Direct Unit-Head-final approval path for CL/RH without substitute gate.

Name: New CL/RH — Rejected
Status / Purpose: Direct Unit-Head-final rejection path for CL/RH without substitute gate.

Name: New Higher-Sanction Leave — Approved
Status / Purpose: Higher-sanction approval path with optional configured Establishment step.

Name: New Higher-Sanction Leave — Rejected
Status / Purpose: Higher-sanction rejection path with optional configured Establishment step.

Name: Director Self-Sanction — Approved
Status / Purpose: Director-applicant new-leave self-sanction approval after any required substitute gate.

Name: Director Self-Sanction — Rejected
Status / Purpose: Director-applicant new-leave self-sanction rejection after any required substitute gate.

Name: CL/RH Approved-Leave Cancellation — Approved
Status / Purpose: Unit-Head-final pre-start cancellation approval.

Name: CL/RH Approved-Leave Cancellation — Rejected
Status / Purpose: Unit-Head-final pre-start cancellation rejection; original approval preserved.

Name: Higher-Sanction Approved-Leave Cancellation — Approved
Status / Purpose: Higher-sanction cancellation approval through the same applicable hierarchy.

Name: Higher-Sanction Approved-Leave Cancellation — Rejected
Status / Purpose: Higher-sanction cancellation rejection; original approval preserved.

Name: Extension — Substitute Consent Accepted (No Loop)
Status / Purpose: Substitute-consent prefix for an admissible EL/COL/VL extension.

Name: Extension — Substitute Declined, Replacement Accepted (One Loop Traversal)
Status / Purpose: Exactly one extension substitute-decline recovery traversal.

Name: Ongoing Leave Extension — Approved
Status / Purpose: Higher-sanction extension approval; only incremental additional period posted.

Name: Ongoing Leave Extension — Rejected
Status / Purpose: Higher-sanction extension rejection; original ongoing leave preserved.

Name: Normal Resumption Review
Status / Purpose: Sanctioning Authority review; no leave-period/balance adjustment.

Name: Early Resumption Review
Status / Purpose: Early return review; actual period/balance and records synchronized.

Name: Late Resumption Review
Status / Purpose: Late return review; actual period/balance and records synchronized.

Name: New Leave Processing and Pending Withdrawal
Status / Purpose: End-to-end new-leave progression including substitute recovery, CL/RH and higher-sanction decisions, Director self-sanction, and cross-cutting pending withdrawal.

Name: Approved Leave Cancellation
Status / Purpose: Pre-start cancellation through the same applicable decision hierarchy, with approved/rejected effects.

Name: Ongoing Leave Extension
Status / Purpose: EL/COL/VL extension with validation, substitute recovery, higher-sanction decision, and pending-extension withdrawal.

Name: Resumption Review
Status / Purpose: Normal/early/late resumption review by applicable Sanctioning Authority without generic closure state.

Name: Cross-Cutting SLA Routing / Responsibility Escalation
Status / Purpose: Automatic System transition used only when configured SLA escalation changes routing/responsibility; notification-only escalation is not a WF transition.
